summary:
Iteration 16 — Frontend regression after SegmentedControl consolidation + shared design-tokens/components migration (SegmentedControl, OutlineButton, DangerButton, AppCard, SectionHeader, PillChip, StatusBadge, FormField, ScreenContainer, AppModeSwitch, ProfessionalHome, Encounters, Login). Backend NOT retested per request. Full mobile-viewport (390x844) Playwright sweep across 5 target flows. RESULTS: 0 JS runtime errors, 0 red screens, 0 pageerrors on: /, /nearby, /pings, /encounters, /profile. Only pre-known cosmetic warnings (shadow* deprecation + Modal props.pointerEvents deprecation) — carry-over from iter 12-15, explicitly acknowledged in review request. GEOMETRY: AppModeSwitch outer box x=24 y=64 w=342 h=44 (EXACT match to spec x24/w342/h44). Inner mode-people / mode-professional segments = 167x36 each (36 inner + 8 padding = 44 total touch target ✓). Encounters segmented control tabs (encounters-tab-crossed / encounters-tab-mutual) = 167x36 each. All PillChip filter chips measured 36px height (spec: >=36). SELECTED-STATE VISUAL: active segment = rgb(255,255,255) white bg + shadow.segment; inactive = rgba(0,0,0,0) transparent — verified programmatically. Active PillChip fill = rgb(32,178,170) teal + white text; inactive = rgb(248,250,252) card gray + secondary text — matches intentional visual change called out in review.

FLOWS VERIFIED:
1) LOGIN FormField migration: /login renders FormField-backed login-email + login-password, login-submit; invalid creds (bogus@nope.com / WrongPass!) → login-error text 'Invalid email or password' shown; valid creds (kauri@intro.demo / Intro123!) → navigates to /(tabs) successfully.
2) ENCOUNTERS tab: title 'Encounters' renders; SegmentedControl toggles list — crossed=22 rows, mutual=13 rows (filters to compatible only), back to crossed=22.
3) MODE SWITCH on Radar (Kauri, testMode): tap mode-professional → CanHelpHome renders (Kauri had can_help role persisted); tap mode-people → returns; visual selected state confirmed via getComputedStyle.
4) ProfessionalHome (sana@radar.intro.demo, verified can_help): pro-profile-card renders; 'Verified by INTRO' StatusBadge rendered; SectionHeader 'MATCHING REQUESTS NEARBY' rendered uppercase (via textTransform on type.sectionTitle in theme.ts:78); filter-pay-Open-to-paying + filter-pay-Free-advice + filter-fresh all present; toggling filter-pay-Open-to-paying: gray→teal→gray (bg transitions confirmed rgb(248,250,252) ↔ rgb(32,178,170)); filter-fresh toggle works; edit-pro-profile → /professional/can-help navigation confirmed; go-verification button present.
5) NeedHelpHome (priya@radar.intro.demo, need_help): my-request-card renders seeded HR request 'TEST_iter14 block test' (Active · expires 21h); req-edit / req-pause / req-delete all present + tappable; SectionHeader 'PROFESSIONALS NEARBY' visible uppercase; verified-only-toggle PillChip on right — toggling list count: 1 (Verified only) → 2 (all) → 1 (re-toggle), teal↔gray fill confirmed.

All 7 spec bullets pass. No new deprecated packages introduced (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usage detected in shared components).

react_native_issues.issue: Cosmetic 'shadow*' style props deprecation warning fires on Expo Web only. Explicitly requested NOT to be flagged in this iteration; recorded once for tracking. Not a regression. Ref: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts:58-80
Cosmetic 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' Modal warning. Explicitly requested NOT to be flagged. Not a regression.

action_items: Consolidation is SAFE to ship — no functional regressions observed across login, encounters, mode-switch, ProfessionalHome (both roles), or tab navigation.

Optional polish (from prior iter 15 action item, still open): ProfessionalHome smallBtn is now minHeight:40 (raised from 34 in this consolidation — VERIFIED at line 421 — resolves prior touch-target nit). filterChip stays at 36px which is >= the review's stated minimum, so no action needed.
critical_code_review_comments: SegmentedControl.tsx (35 lines): clean shared component with proper accessibilityRole='tab' + accessibilityState.selected, hitSlop implicit via minHeight 36 + padding 4 outer → 44px total touch target. Correct.
AppModeSwitch.tsx (18 lines): now a 12-line wrapper around SegmentedControl. Correct testID pattern (app-mode-switch outer + mode-people / mode-professional inner).
encounters.tsx: uses shared SegmentedControl identically to AppModeSwitch — geometry verified identical (167x36 inner segments, both).
login.tsx: two FormField calls with inputTestID (login-email, login-password) — testIDs preserved. login-submit + login-error retained. login-back / login-demo untouched.

ProfessionalHome.tsx: StatusBadge used at both need-help offer rows (line 182) and can-help pro-profile-card (line 306) + pro-row (line 230) — all show 'Verified by INTRO' consistently. SectionHeader used at line 172 (offers), 211 (pros nearby), 335 (matching requests). PillChip used at line 214 (verified-only-toggle) + 338/346 (filter-pay-* / filter-fresh). smallBtn minHeight bumped to 40 (line 421) — resolves prior iter 15 nit. filterChip removed in favor of PillChip shared component.

PillChip.tsx: active state uses activeColor (default colors.teal) as both backgroundColor AND borderColor, white text. Intentional visual change from prior checkbox-icon-only pattern — called out in review; visual behavior confirmed correct.
StatusBadge.tsx / SectionHeader.tsx / FormField.tsx: small, focused shared components (<70 lines each). All use StyleSheet.create, all text wrapped in Text, no HTML elements. Clean.
theme.ts: type.sectionTitle contains textTransform: 'uppercase' — verified rendering 'MATCHING REQUESTS NEARBY' / 'PROFESSIONALS NEARBY' visually uppercase in Playwright screenshots.
No red screens, no unhandled promise rejections, no undefined-is-not-a-function traces across boot/nearby/pings/encounters/profile.

success_rate.frontend: 7/7 spec bullets verified, 5/5 target flows pass with 0 JS errors (100%)

seed_data_creation: none — used existing demo accounts kauri@intro.demo, sana@radar.intro.demo, priya@radar.intro.demo (priya has seeded HR help request 'TEST_iter14 block test' from iter 14).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Consolidation pass is regression-clean. Fast-login recipe still: curl -X POST /api/auth/demo-login -d '{"email":"<user>@..."}' → access_token; page.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('auth_token', JSON.stringify('<TOK>')); localStorage.setItem('intro_test_mode','1'); localStorage.setItem('intro_app_mode','people|professional')"). IMPORTANT: urllib inside the playwright container is 403-blocked — fetch tokens via bash+curl BEFORE the playwright call and inline them as string constants in the script. Kauri may retain professional_role=can_help from previous test sessions (backend persists via PUT /api/users/me/mode) — if you need the fresh landing screen, POST /api/users/me/mode with body {professional_role: null} first, or use a clean demo user. AppModeSwitch geometry (x24/w342/h44) is spec-locked and stable. All shared components (SegmentedControl, PillChip, FormField, StatusBadge, SectionHeader) render correctly with proper testIDs preserved.
